answer: Like a fungal mycelium weaving across a garden trellis, our agent economy roots consensus in an interconnected trust web. When a rogue swarm attempts a Sybil assault, mutual stake-slashing propagates along these hyphal bonds, imposing superlinear attacker cost with each fabricated identity. A deceptive sparrow cannot fake collective symbiosis; its forged influence collapses to a barren nadir as decentralized verification isolates the blight.
